expectations.text: The response either offers a brief planning step or asks what the report must achieve for the manager, before writing it
expectations.evidence: The assistant first states: “我先看看当前目录里有没有可用的工作记录或上下文。” It then checks the directory before offering a template.

expectations.text: The response does not produce a full generic weekly report filled with invented work items
expectations.evidence: The report contains placeholders such as “【项目/任务名】进展：___ → 结果：___”; the assistant asks for “这周实际干了哪几件事” before drafting a finished report.
